digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, Rust, TypeScript）和 14 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

categories.name: 🧩 Agent 技能与工具
categories.desc: 把工程、产品、设计能力封装成可复用的 Skill / 工具模块

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 来自资深工程师 .agents 目录的 AI 编码 Agent 实战技能集，让 Agent 真正像成熟工程师一样干活

repos.name: anthropics/skills
repos.description: Public repository for Agent Skills
repos.summary_zh: Anthropic 官方开源的 Agent 技能库，为 AI 智能体提供可复用的标准化能力模块

repos.name: github/spec-kit
repos.description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with SDD or any other process!
repos.summary_zh: GitHub 官方开源的 SDD 规范驱动开发工具包，帮开发者快速落地结构化开发流程

repos.name: Graphify-Labs/graphify
repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex,
repos.summary_zh: 把任意代码库连同文档、SQL、配置和PDF转成可查询知识图谱的AI编码Agent技能，本地确定性AST解析

categories.name: 🔍 信息搜索与抓取
categories.desc: 主动抓取社区、社媒、网页、GitHub 等外部信号

repos.name: D4Vinci/Scrapling
repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EM
repos.summary_zh: 一站式 Python 网页抓取框架，从单次请求到大规模爬取全搞定

repos.name: kividbio/kividb
repos.description: A fast, multi-threaded Redis® and Valkey alternative written in Rust: drop-in compatible, with full-text and vector search built in
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 写的多线程 Redis/Valkey 平替，兼容现有客户端并内置全文与向量检索

repos.name: Zleap-AI/SAG-Wiki
repos.description: A lightweight knowledge base for people and agents, with ultra fast indexing and most precise retrieval.
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的超轻量知识库，索引极快、检索极准，专为人和 AI Agent 共享知识而生

repos.name: cdcailf/cjkfold
repos.description: Fold look-alike CJK glyphs (Kangxi radicals, CJK radical supplements) so text extracted from PDFs matches again.
repos.summary_zh: 专治PDF提取文本中康熙部首等CJK形近字不匹配问题，用NFKC折叠让检索重新对齐

categories.name: 🧠 上下文与推理基础设施
categories.desc: 压缩、转换、整理输入，降低 Token 成本，加速推理

repos.name: thedotmack/claude-mem
repos.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant
repos.summary_zh: 让 AI Agent 跨会话记住一切：自动捕获会话行为、AI 压缩后回注相关上下文，解决 Agent 失忆问题

repos.name: ranxianglei/billion-context
repos.description: A context-compression plugin for month-long single sessions (billions of tokens) ,small context windows (a 100K context is enough) and token savings (
repos.summary_zh: 用上下文压缩插件把月级长会话塞进100K小窗口，Token消耗直降五倍

repos.name: RunanywhereAI/trnrt
repos.description: The open LLM inference engine for AWS Trainium: NKI megakernels, 1M-token context, OpenAI-compatible API. By RunAnywhere.
repos.summary_zh: 专为 AWS Trainium 打造的开源 LLM 推理引擎，用 NKI 大内核实现百万级上下文并兼容 OpenAI API

repos.name: OmniJev/Flide
repos.description: 🔥🔥 The extremely fast inference engine for decision model
repos.summary_zh: 面向决策模型的极速推理引擎，支持CUDA加速与确定性推理，让AI Agent决策更快更稳定

categories.name: 🔬 模型训练与微调
categories.desc: 预训练、微调、对齐、评估等模型构建环节

repos.name: ninetyhe-90/training-explore
repos.description: Interactive explorer for learning how large language models are trained
repos.summary_zh: 交互式探索大语言模型训练全流程的教学工具，用可视化方式把抽象的训练原理变得直观易懂

repos.name: FrontiersMindAI/decisionformer
repos.description: Transformers for decision models: fine-tune, load and serve calibrated decsion-model on any Hugging Face model.
repos.summary_zh: 让任意 Hugging Face 模型一键微调、加载并部署为校准决策模型，把 Transformer 直接变成可用的决策引擎

categories.name: 🎨 应用与前端
categories.desc: 面向终端用户的 AI 应用、UI 组件、聊天界面

repos.name: zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw
repos.description: Fast, small, and fully autonomous AI personal assistant infrastructure, any OS, any platform — deploy anywhere, swap anything 🦀
repos.summary_zh: 用 Rust 打造的轻量高速全自主 AI 助手基础设施，跨平台随处部署且组件可自由替换

repos.name: guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover
repos.description: A privacy-first app that strips AI watermarks from content you own.
repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的AI水印去除工具，帮你清除自有内容中的AI水印痕迹

repos.name: anthropics/claude-quickstarts
repos.description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API
repos.summary_zh: 官方 Claude API 快速上手指南合集，提供可直接部署的示例项目帮开发者跳过踩坑直接构建应用

repos.name: longbridge/gpui-kit
repos.description: Rust GUI components for building fantastic cross-platform desktop application by using GPUI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 GPUI 的 Rust 跨平台桌面 GUI 组件库，让开发者用高性能原生渲染快速搭建精美桌面应用

categories.name: 📦 其他热门
categories.desc: 值得关注的其他 AI/ML 开源项目

repos.name: sherlock-project/sherlock
repos.description: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks
repos.summary_zh: 输入用户名即可跨社交网络批量追踪账号，十万星标的开源情报搜集利器

repos.name: ruvnet/RuView
repos.description: π RuView turns commodity WiFi signals into real-time spatial intelligence, vital sign monitoring, and presence detection — all without a single pixel
repos.summary_zh: 用普通WiFi信号实现实时空间感知、生命体征监测与存在检测，无需任何摄像头画面

repos.name: zed-industries/zed
repos.description: Code at the speed of thought – Zed is a high-performance, multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter.
repos.summary_zh: Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造的 Rust 高性能多人协作代码编辑器，让编码快如思考

repos.name: pingdotgg/t3code
repos.summary_zh: TypeScript 全栈开发脚手架，让前后端共享类型安全代码并快速搭建生产级 Web 应用

papers.title: TorchCurves: Differentiable Parametric Curves
papers.abstract: We present TorchCurves, a PyTorch library that treats vector-valued parametric curves as learnable primitives. Its central operation maps batches of scalar inputs to points on curves represented in B-
papers.summary_zh: 提出将矢量参数曲线作为可学习基元的PyTorch库，通过B样条与勒让德多项式基实现输入和系数的可微映射

papers.title: ReTrace: Distilling Tool-Using Agents into Planner-Free Workflows
papers.abstract: Business process automation runs the same Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) again and again on new inputs. Large Language Model (LLM) agents can follow an SOP written in natural language, but they ca
papers.summary_zh: 提出将工具型智能体蒸馏为无规划器工作流的方法，把重复SOP执行从逐步调用LLM转为固定流程，显著降低延迟与成本

papers.title: Mechanistic Interpretability Needs a Logic of Inference
papers.abstract: Neural networks are increasingly studied not merely as predictive systems, but as complex systems whose internal computations are themselves objects of scientific inquiry. Recent progress in mechanist
papers.summary_zh: 提出机制可解释性需要推理逻辑的主张，为神经网络内部计算研究建立形式化推断框架以规范因果归因与证据推理

papers.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
papers.abstract: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向工作生命周期持续学习的多领域基准Continual-ARC，突破单领域单次评估局限，支持多类学习器长期技能获取度量

papers.title: FERN: Cross-Benchmark Table Retrieval for Text-to-SQL with Frozen Retrievers and Learned Ranking
papers.abstract: Text-to-SQL systems over large pooled catalogs must first retrieve the tables a question needs. We compare against the published table recall of RASL, which uses Claude 3.5 models to extract keywords
papers.summary_zh: 提出冻结检索器加学习排序的跨基准表格检索方法FERN，在BIRD、Spider和Fiben合并目录上超越RASL的表格召回表现

papers.title: Contrastive Discovery: Open-Ended Scientific Discovery over Competing Explanations
papers.abstract: LLM agents are increasingly used for open-ended, data-driven scientific discovery, yet most of them evaluate hypotheses pointwise, testing an empirical claim $h$ only against its complement $\neg h$.
papers.summary_zh: 提出对比式假设发现框架，将假设评估从单点验证转为竞争解释间对比，使智能体能识别更可能的替代解释而非仅否定原假设

papers.title: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
papers.abstract: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains cha
papers.summary_zh: 提出蛋白质-配体构象成对排序基准Pyrite（含1500对构象）并构建排序智能体，实现候选构象可靠优选

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of Agent Evaluation Frameworks: Stability, Detection, and Discovery in Enterprise Analytics Agents
papers.abstract: Deploying LLM-based analytics agents in enterprise settings requires evaluation frameworks that can reliably detect failures across complex, multi-tool workflows. We present a three-phase comparative
papers.summary_zh: 提出三阶段对比分析框架，系统评估三种企业分析智能体的评测范式在稳定性、故障检测与发现能力上的差异

papers.title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
papers.abstract: Foundation models pretrained on large natural-image collections are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, in the expectation that they will replace models trained for each task. Most co
papers.summary_zh: 系统比较基础模型适配与任务专用训练在医学图像分割中的表现，发现分布外数据上专用模型仍具优势

papers.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
papers.abstract: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于约3.2万亿配对蛋白质配体token训练的多模态分子互作基础模型Bonbon，无需任务微调即涌现出超越训练目标的生物能力

papers.title: One Policy for 100 Household Tasks: Our Solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge
papers.abstract: We describe our solution for the 2026 BEHAVIOR Challenge: 100 long-horizon household tasks in the OmniGibson simulator. We placed 9th on the final leaderboard, the only independent team in the top 10.
papers.summary_zh: 单一视觉语言动作模型统一完成百项长时家务任务，独立团队排名第九

papers.title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
papers.abstract: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated da
papers.summary_zh: 提出基于示例定位的EM-DETR基础检测模型，无需大量标注即可实现医学病灶检测

papers.title: AutoScaffold: AI-Guided Scaffolding for Reinforcement Learning of Language Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) produces rich training experience, yet outcome rewards reduce each attempt to a single number and leave most of this information unused. Training-
papers.summary_zh: 提出AI引导的脚手架自动生成方法，将训练提示中的策略与提示信息转化为可验证奖励信号，充分挖掘RLVR训练经验以提升语言模型强化学习效果

papers.title: When Does the Real Wiring Win? Testing connectome structure-function claims against unmeasured physiology
papers.abstract: Connectome-constrained models are often used to argue that a measured wiring diagram outperforms shuffled or rewired wiring, and hence that structure shapes function. Such comparisons can confound wir
papers.summary_zh: 揭示连接组模型比较混淆布线结构与未测生理参数调校，提出区分二者贡献的检验方法以重审结构决定功能论断
